items.question: Is the treatment painful?
items.answer: Most treatments are performed under local anesthesia, so you won't feel pain during the procedure. Some mild discomfort afterward is normal and easily managed with medication.

items.question: How long do I need to stay in Turkey?
items.answer: It depends on your treatment plan, but most patients stay between 3 and 7 days. Your clinic will confirm the exact duration once your treatment plan is ready.

items.question: Do you provide warranty?
items.answer: Yes, clinics on Dentaloria offer a warranty on most treatments. Coverage terms vary by clinic and treatment type — ask for full details in your free quote.

items.question: Can I get a temporary teeth?
items.answer: Yes, temporary teeth are available for most implant and full-mouth treatments so you don't have to wait to smile with confidence.

items.question: What is included in the treatment package?
items.answer: Packages typically include the treatment itself, consultations, and X-rays. Many clinics also offer airport transfers and hotel assistance — confirm exact inclusions with the clinic.
